text: The share table is precise and the block bars in a fourth column hint at proportion; there is no pie or donut, only numbers and commentary.
a2ui: Currency formatting nested in a format string and bound rows work nicely, but shares are again block characters in a Text because the catalog cannot draw a part-of-whole chart.
html: An SVG donut with tap-to-focus slices and checkboxes that drop a category and recompute every share, so hiding rent shows how the other $1,500 divides.
agui: The breakdown is a disabled table, but picking categories with checkboxes and a reduction slider yields a well-typed savings goal for the agent to act on.
